Do our people need a technical background?
No. People shape the workspace by describing what they need in plain language. We handle the set-up and connections, and help your team use and adjust the workspace and its workflows.
Which AI models and tools does it work with?

Enamplify connects to a set of supported model accounts and business tools, and that set changes over time. We confirm what your setup needs during the diagnostic, rather than promising that every subscription, history or plugin will carry across.
Only where you have approved. Before anything is connected, we agree which information the workspace may use, which accounts it reaches and who can see what.
How do we know it worked?
We agree a starting point and two or three measures before we begin, such as time spent on a task or review effort, and we report against them. Logging in is not an outcome.

No. Outcomes depend on your data, approvals and people, which we do not control, and agents work within the jobs and limits you give them. We price the first steps so you can see value before committing to more.
